record.question: Which noted flute player received Sangeet Natak Akademi award?
record.explanation: Answer B: Rajendra Prasanna. Rajendra Prasanna is the flute/shehnai player among these awardees. The Culture Ministry’s 5 February 2019 announcement lists the 2017 Akademi Awards and identifies him as Hindustani Instrumental—Shehnai/Flute. It identifies Lalith J.Rao as a vocalist and Yogesh Samsi as a tabla player, so their receipt of awards does not make them answers to the flute-player question. Historical/source note: The 2017 award cohort was selected in June 2018 and presented in February 2019. Rajendra Prasanna’s category is shehnai/flute; source option Yogesh Sansi misspells Samsi. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=188042. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
